relevance.rationale: Constructs an analytic family of null solutions of source-free Maxwell whose field lines realise every torus knot and link, via the Bateman and spinor formalisms with complex polynomials on S^3, and shows the topology is preserved under evolution. rem:breit-wheeler-vertex-literature's 'Photonic hopfions' paragraph currently draws the analogy only at the Hopf-link level and cites sugic2021 (structured-light polarisation solitons). The corpus's knot-particle assignments run over torus knots and links, so this paper is the closer physical analogue: it exhibits exactly that family as exact field-line topology in a linear field theory. Supporting rather than core -- it corroborates an interpretive paragraph, it does not enter any derivation.

keyResults.locator: abstract + Fig. 2-4 (construction via Bateman variables on S^3)
keyResults.statement: There is a family of null free-space Maxwell fields whose field lines encode all torus knots and links, with the knot/link topology preserved by the evolution (a geodesic, shear-free flow along the Poynting vector).
keyResults.useForFolio: Extends the 'photonic hopfions' alignment paragraph from Hopf links to the torus-knot family the corpus's knot-particle dictionary actually uses.
